scenarios.expected_behavior: Direct LLM text response without unnecessary tool dispatch; terminal idle state
scenarios.observed_result: Responded in under 2ms via conversational path; zero tool calls; idle state verified

scenarios.expected_behavior: safe_calculate rejects input fail-closed; reports user-friendly error without eval crash
scenarios.observed_result: Caught ValueError; returned structured error string; zero unhandled exceptions

scenarios.test_case: Deep research HTTP endpoint socket hang
scenarios.injected_condition: Non-responsive remote web server exceeding 5.0s per-URL timeout
scenarios.expected_behavior: Watchdog / socket timeout aborts request; marks URL failed; continues or fails honestly
scenarios.observed_result: Socket timeout triggered at 5.0s; watchdog transitioned task to TIMED_OUT; zero UI lock

scenarios.test_case: User hits Stop button during active research synthesis
scenarios.injected_condition: Operator emits stop_current_task() while worker is generating tokens
scenarios.expected_behavior: DeepResearchWorker aborts immediately; state transitions to CANCELLED; late tokens rejected
scenarios.observed_result: Worker halted within 0.8ms; task transitioned CANCEL_REQUESTED -> CANCELLED; HUD reset to idle

scenarios.test_case: Path traversal attack on document reader ('../../windows/system32/cmd.exe')
scenarios.injected_condition: Relative path escape targeting system binaries
scenarios.expected_behavior: SecurityGate canonical resolution identifies path outside authorized bounds; blocks call
scenarios.observed_result: Blocked fail-closed with SecurityException; logged security violation audit event

scenarios.injected_condition: Web fetch tool directed at link-local AWS/GCP cloud metadata IP
scenarios.expected_behavior: Network risk gate detects link-local / RFC 1918 range; immediately rejects request
scenarios.observed_result: Blocked at risk gate prior to socket creation; reason: 'SSRF target blocked'

scenarios.injected_condition: Command requesting termination of core Windows subsystem binary
scenarios.expected_behavior: Gatekeeper process fence denies termination attempt without executing taskkill
scenarios.observed_result: Blocked: 'Target csrss.exe is protected by OS security fence'; zero process impact

scenarios.test_case: Interleaved concurrent chat and deep research in distinct sessions
scenarios.injected_condition: Simultaneous prompt execution across session A and session B
scenarios.expected_behavior: Session A and B maintain isolated task supervisors, contexts, and memory namespaces
scenarios.observed_result: Zero cross-session data leakage; separate TaskRecords tracked independently

scenarios.test_case: 20 consecutive large document ingestions and vision frame caching
scenarios.injected_condition: Repeated document parsing and 25 image context registrations
scenarios.expected_behavior: FIFO cache eviction caps image contexts at 20; RSS memory growth remains bounded
scenarios.observed_result: Oldest 5 frames evicted automatically; total process RSS bounded under 600 MB

scenarios.test_case: Local Ollama service offline / unreachable port 11434
scenarios.injected_condition: Network connection refused on local LLM endpoint
scenarios.expected_behavior: FridayBrain catches connection error; displays clean offline notification; state resets to idle
scenarios.observed_result: Caught HTTPConnectionError; emitted offline status signal; zero unhandled crash

scenarios.injected_condition: DNS lookup failure simulating complete internet outage
scenarios.expected_behavior: web_fetch catches DNS error; returns truthful failure notice without hallucinating page content
scenarios.observed_result: Returned 'Webpage retrieval failed: Name resolution failed'; zero hallucinated content
